articles.author: Dalia Faheid
articles.title: Mississippi police make arrest in Tasia Fortune case after medical examiner rules death a homicide - cnn.com
articles.description: Police in Jackson, Mississippi, have arrested a man in the case of Tasia Fortune, the 29-year-old Black woman found hanging from a tree outside an abandoned house last month, following the state medical examiner ruling her death a homicide.
